newsitem.title: ITALY: Bell chief says interested in bigger Omnitel stake.
newsitem.headline: Bell chief says interested in bigger Omnitel stake.

text.p: Bell Atlantic International would seriously consider any opportunity to raise its stake in Italian GSM phone service operator Omnitel, Bell's chairman Thomas Bartlett was quoted as saying on Tuesday.
"We will evaluate carefully any opportunity to increase our stake further," Bartlett said. "Everything depends on the company's results and the price at which shares would be offered."

The Omnitel Pronto-Italia consortium is Italy's second mobile phone service operator. It is 70 percent controlled by Olivetti -led Omnitel Sistemi Radiocellulari Italiani (OSR) and 30 percent by Pronto Italia, a consortium including Air Touch and Germany's Mannesmann.
Last December Bell bought an 8.26 percent stake in OSR from troubled Italian information and technology group Olivetti, raising its total holding to 24.9 percent.
Bartlett said that 1997 had started well for Omnitel even if "our success depends on the steps the Italian government takes to liberalise the market."
